title: Civil Engineer Draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you worked in a role where you were responsible for authoring and reviewing technical documentation?
Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK with resume and cover letter. Advert listed 1 Oct 2026.
rationale: Draftsperson title at a manufacturer matches entry drafting; Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design is listed among ideal qualifications.
Discipline is timber truss and Pryda documentation rather than road or stormwater, so overlap is drafting and construction documentation only.
Ipswich QLD needs relocation discussion; no citizenship gate in the advert; experience is ideal not mandatory.
caution: Pryda/MiTech not used; drafting experience is coursework; timber truss is outside Marc civil roads focus.
